name: grokbot-model-watch
description: Shows what can actually be known about which model is behind each of your Grok Bots, graded by evidence: Cursor's signed per-request identifier (Enterprise inference hooks), your Cursor usage ledger, and what the Bot says about itself. Gives Bots a which-model skill and tools so they answer honestly instead of guessing.

MODEL_WATCH_URL.title: Model Watch public URL
MODEL_WATCH_URL.description: The base https:// URL where Cursor's servers can reach your companion, without a trailing slash or /mcp (for example https://watch.example.com). Bots run in the cloud, so localhost never works here; a tunnel (Cloudflare Tunnel, Tailscale Funnel, ngrok) or a small VPS is fine. Leave both variables empty to use only the dashboard and the which-model skill.

MODEL_WATCH_TOKEN.title: Model Watch bearer token
MODEL_WATCH_TOKEN.description: The token printed by `grokbot-model-watch token`. Cursor stores it and sends it from its servers when a Bot calls the companion's tools; rotate it with `token --rotate` if the plugin is removed or a Bot is shared.
